rationale: Held texts re-hashed and spans exact: ORIGINAL:EO:10773 (ae4640e8..., 23 FR 5061, July 1, 1958; held text truncated at "Continued on p. 5063", so later sections including the sec. 7 referenced in sec. 2(b) are not held), ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11051 (FR original, 27 FR 9683) and the ACT record (APP mirror span 25113-25774, scope machine-marked partial). EO 11051 sec. 604 does say "To the extent that the following have not heretofore been made or become inapplicable, they are hereby superseded and revoked" and lists (9) Executive Order No. 10773 of July 1, 1958; the only savings parenthetical attaches to item (7) EO 10539; EO 10958 sec. 304 supersedes prior orders only for functions it delegates, so it is partial. That evidence supports a provisional NO, which is exactly what the rationale concludes. But the decision records recommended_provisional_status "yes", with no CURRENT predicate and no check through 2026-10-14. The recommendation field is the operative output and it contradicts the decision's own basis and reasoning, so the decision cannot be accepted even though the underlying analysis points to NO. History flag PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLAUSE_CHECK is otherwise reasonably explained. The cruden number search (17 files) shows no revival after 1962, but it also shows EO 10941 citing 10773, which the producer does not discuss.

Held texts re-hashed (EO_10946.txt 380a6151..., EO_11374.txt 124f998e...) and the ACT span 2255-2318 matches the bytes exactly: "Sec. 6. Executive Order No. 10946 of May 26, 1961, is hereby revoked." The identity of the original matches the API observation (26 FR 4629, signed 1961-05-26, same title). I read the original in full: secs. 1-8 establish and run the Missile Sites Labor Commission, its site committees, panels and procedures; sec. 9 makes an emergency-fund finding and authorizes FY1961/FY1962 payments and compensation. I read EO 11374 in full (32 FR 14199, signed 1967-10-11, published 1967-10-13). Sec. 1 abolishes the Commission and transfers its functions to FMCS; secs. 2-5 cover continued priority procedures, agency cooperation, records and property, and pending disputes; sec. 6 is an unqualified whole-order revocation with no savings or delayed-effect language. The producer asserts no effective date beyond signing and leaves residuals open, which is correct. The cruden number search (4 hits) finds only EO 11374 (FR, APP and 1989 copies) and the original, so no contrary end and no revival appears. The history has no flags and both observations were reviewed. Minor imprecision: the statement that no command has an own-terms end overlooks sec. 9's fiscal-year-limited (FY1961-62) payment authority. The producer retains that point as a lifecycle gap, and it is a partial clause matter that does not affect the whole-order NO. The provisional NO is supported only as a nonauthoritative proposal; first-effective cessation, residual effects and a complete later-source search remain lifecycle gaps.
